children: The March 2032 gilt looks cheap and this should support demand at the bond's auction due at 0900 GMT, RBC Capital Markets strategists say in a note. The supply of U.K. 5-year government bonds is likely to be relatively limited, making the bonds favorable to buy at Tuesday's auction, the strategists say. March 2032 gilt yields rise 4.8 basis points to last trade at 4.927%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
